verdict.rationale: Deel documents global payroll processing and says it exposes payroll data to agents through its MCP server, but nothing in the evidence mentions payroll registers, gross-to-net reports, or exporting reports for analysis. 'Real-time cost visibility' and MCP access to payroll data are adjacent capabilities, not the reporting and export capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can generate payroll registers and gross-to-net reports and export them for analysis
